title: Dot announcer
description: A vermilion dot display changes its illuminated glyph and status with a short column-by-column handoff.
useCase: Compact status that communicates across a room or at small sizes.
reducedMotion: Dots change state immediately with no delayed transition.
limitations: Three local display states; no connected device or broadcast service.
look: Vermilion plastic device on a red field, framing a dark maroon grid of round dots with cream lit dots forming an icon and letters.
motion: Choosing a state recolours each dot over 180 ms with a 7 ms-per-column delay, so the new icon and three-letter word sweep in left to right.
adapt: Each `circle` gets an inline fill transition with `transitionDelay` of `x * 7` ms; lit dots come from `PATTERNS` (9×9 icons) and the 5×7 `GLYPHS` font. Replace `PATTERNS`, `LABELS` and the three-letter words inside `lit`, adding letters to `GLYPHS` as needed.
